notes.title: April 24 update
notes.notes:
Korean localization added.

Some bugs fixed.

notes.title: New update now available - *WARNING* not compatible with previous save data
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

A new patch is now available with several improvements as well as a fix for the save game corruption found during a secondary mission.

WARNING! The update from this patch is not compatible with current save games, so you will lose your progression and your save game will be deleted if you download this patch. 

•	Multiple gameplay bugs fixed.
•	Korean language added for the texts and the trophies
